result.rationale: The diff changes `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration !== "google_calendar"` to destructure `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` followed by `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` without optional chaining. When destinationCalendar is null/empty (users without a calendar app), destructuring yields undefined and the unchained `.integration` access throws a TypeError, breaking the Google Meet → Cal Video fallback path and the booking flow. The mechanism is verifiable directly in EventManager.ts.

judged_text: The new destructuring `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` followed by `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` crashes with a TypeError when destinationCalendar is null or an empty array, because the code no longer uses optional chaining before accessing .integration. Any booking without a destination calendar (the common case for users with no calendar app connected) that selects Cal Video as location throws `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'integration')` inside EventManager, failing the entire booking flow with a 500 instead of falling back to daily video as the previous code (`evt.destinationCalendar?.integration`) did.
